title: Crash on startup (Windows on ARM, any Godot version)
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible: 4.3, 4.4, 4.4.1, 4.5-beta3 (both emulated and native ARM)

### System information

Windows 11 on ARM - Godot 4.4.1 - Qualcomm Snapgradon 8cx Gen 3

### Issue description
